rows.label: VALID
rows.notes: After an August/early-September decline and repair, the 9/18 bar recaptured the tight 10/20 EMA area from a contracted range and closed at the session high. Added as an independent 9/18 positive Wedge Pop example.

rows.label: FALSE_POSITIVE
rows.notes: The mechanical gap conditions are present, but AMD was independently reviewed in this same session as a VALID Exhaustion Extension. Kell explicitly distinguishes early-cycle constructive gaps from gaps occurring while already extended; therefore the buyable-gap label is misleading in cycle context.

earlyTrend.definition: Adjacent archived sessions, first new entry per 63-session cooldown. Next close to horizon close, equal signal-date weights. Leader = top decile of the signal-date eligible universe with both exit and entry quotes.

matched.method: Controls from the same evaluated date, same previous radar stage, with price and momentum measured through the preceding close. Closest controls without reuse per date and cohort. No sector or liquidity matching. Pairs fixed before outcomes. Next close to horizon close; equal weight per observed signal date; gross returns, known corporate actions only.

trendBirthForward.exitRule: h complete exchange sessions after entry close
trendBirthForward.priceSource: as-published EOD closes with source-verified ledger adjustments
trendBirthForward.survivorshipGuard: unmatched tickers excluded; missing mature outcomes counted
